mapper.select: SELECT child_id AS childId, member_id AS memberId, name, birth_date AS birthDate, gender, disorder_type AS disorderType, severity, character_type AS characterType, character_nickname AS characterNickname, created_at AS createdAt FROM child WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE child SET name = #{name}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, gender = #{gender}, disorder_type = #{disorderType}, severity = #{severity} WHERE child_id = #{childId}
